/scripts.value:
on MoveToTrashcan
	
	local tDataA, tTarget, tQuizlisTable,tCollectionsTable,tTheID
	
	put authedUserQuizzesTable into tQuizlisTable
	put authedUserQuizCollectionsTable into tCollectionsTable

	put cdb_tableID(authedUserQuizzesTable) into tQuizlisTable
	put cdb_tableID(authedUserQuizCollectionsTable) into tCollectionsTable
	
	repeat with xQuizli = 1 to item 2 of the extents of lastMoveToTrash["quizlis"]
		put lastMoveToTrash["quizlis"][xQuizli] into tTheID
		put "true" into tDataA[tQuizlisTable][tTheID]["InTrash"]
	end repeat
	
	repeat with xCollection = 1 to item 2 of the extents of lastMoveToTrash["collections"]
		put lastMoveToTrash["collections"][xCollection] into tTheID
		put "true" into tDataA[tCollectionsTable][tTheID]["InTrash"]
	end repeat
	
	cdb_batchUpdate tDataA,"local"	
	cdb_batchUpdate tDataA,"cloud"	
end MoveToTrashcan
